tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// rigs gsum spyi'i rjes gnang gi cho ga srid zhi'i dge legs lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs 'jam pa'i dbyangs// tshad med thugs brtse'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs// mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin// rigs gsum dbyer med bla mar gus btud nas// gang de'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang tshul// 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// snying la sems bzhin gzhan la phan pa'i blos// srid zhi'i dge legs lhun grub 'di na spel// 'dir 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la'ang*/ slob dpon dang slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa gnyis kyi dang po la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa ras la sogs pas bkab la me tog gi sil ma bkram/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar maṇ+ḍal gtsang ma'i dbus su dri'i thig le gru bzhi dang*/ g.yas g.yon du zlum por byugs pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu re bkod/

'byor na rigs gsum gyi sku brnyan bsham zhing*/ rje bla ma'i phyag lena'ang mdzad/ mchan/ mdun du gtor ma gnyis/ mtha' skor du byang shar nas brtsams te mtshams 'dzin me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod rnams g.yas skor du gru bzhir bshams la/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum gdan gyi steng du bum pa tshad ldan kha rgyan mgul chings/ mtshan ma bcas gdags/ drag sngags bzla zhing yungs kar dang gu gul gyis brab bdug byas la/ chu gtsang mas sum gnyis dgang*/ bum sman nyer lnga gzhug steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chu rdor gzungs dang bcas pa dang*/ rdor dril 'thor 'bru/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal me tog bdug rdzas sogs sta gon byas la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang*/ bdag mdun bum gsum rjes gnang dngos dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan pas thog mar mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs mchod pa byin rlabs spyi ltar/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum rol mo dang bcas pa byas la/ de nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs skyabs 'gro ci nus mthar/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs gsol gdab dang*/ sems can thams cad nas/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥser po las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang bcom ldan rigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drang*/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta tri ku la nā tha maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ku la nā tha maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma'i gdan gsum gyi dbus dang g.yas kyi pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang g.yon gyi pad+ma'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas shes rab kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can shin tu mdzes shing zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis spras shing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs gsol ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyi brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas su hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas pas rdo rje thugs kar dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du bsams la/ de nas thal mo gnyis sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug pa mgo bor reg cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ta bha wā ya swā hā/ thal mo sbyar ba pad+ma kha bye ba'i tshul du snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ pad+mo ta bha wā ya swā hā/ thal mo gnyis rgyab sbyar la mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis sbyar nas lte bar reg cing*/ oṃ badz+ro ta bha wā ya swā hā/ zhes rigs gsum gyi dam tshig gi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas lha gsum la rim bzhin du rnam snang*/ 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa rnams kyi dbu brgyan rang chas su bzhugs par bsam mo// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rigs gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang phyag rgyas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ mchod pa gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags re re zhing sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da swā hās mchod/ sku gsung thugs 'jam 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin yon tan rgyas pa'i sku// de phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur mtshan gsol ba// blo gros bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs kar rang rang gi gdan gyi steng du dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ rnams la rang rang gi sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur par bsam/

mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus te rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong dang grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsams shing*/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ zhes gtso bo la brgya rtsa sogs ci nus dang*/ 'khor la de'i bcu cha bcas ji ltar rigs pa bzlas mthar/ mjug tu'ang mchod bstod gong ltar byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs mdun gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan rang la thim pas rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par bsam pa ni bdag bskyed do// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni tshom bu bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma'i gdan gsum gyi steng du dbus dang g.yas su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ g.yon du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las sogs rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor ba ma gtogs/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du bsams la dam tshig gi phyag rgyas byin brlab bcas gong bdag bskyed ltar byas/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang*/ spro na/ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ku la nā tha sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ gong gi mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ rnam snang*/ 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa rnams kyi dbu rgyan rang chas su bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin brlab gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ku la nā tha sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod la dharmā ra ṇi rol chen dang bcas pa byas la/ bstod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ sku gsung thugs 'jam sogs gong bdag bskyed bzhin bstod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa bskyod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na sogs lha sngags gsum sbrel ba'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tri ku la nā tha sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ sku gsung thugs 'jam sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan bdag dang sems can thams cad sogs kyis gsol ba gdab bo// sgos kyi srung ma la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ e h+ye hi ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo zhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i sogs kyis bstod/

nag po chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol lo// de nas mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams la dmigs te/ sngags gsum po brgya sogs ci nus bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs 'dod don gsol gdab byas la/ bum pa sgrub pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du dbus dang g.yas su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ g.yon du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser sogs dang*/ g.yas su 'phags pa spyan ras sogs dang*/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sogs nas/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can zhes pa'i bar gyis bskyed la/ de gsum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par bsams la byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas/ de thams cad kyi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du sngags kyi phreng bas mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ lha sngags gsum po brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas la/ mthar mtshan sngags re re nas sbyar bas/ ar+ghṃ nas/ shab+da rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ lha gsum gyi bstod pas sngar bzhin bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sogs kyis 'dod don zhus te rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/

ma 'byor pa dang zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par bsam pa ni slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral rim bzhin 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang*/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs chos bshad ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te/ de la 'dir rang re rnams kyi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa thub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams phyogs ris su bsdu na theg pa chung ngu dang chen po gnyis su 'du la/ theg pa chen po la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi sde snod gnyis las/ 'dir rig sngags 'chang ba'i sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ bya ba spyi yin/ de la spyod pa bzhi po'i don 'dus shing ma tshang ba med par ston pa dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa smin byed gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi'i rgyud/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa lha'i rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa legs par grub pa'i rgyud/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud de bzhi yod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa'i rgyud dam/ gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po kha che ye shes rdo rjes cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig spyod rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum spyi'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa ste/

de yang bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs su grub pas gang gis bsnyen cing sgrub pa rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi snying po/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab/ khams gsum yongs la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje/ bdud dang bdud kyi ris kyi mi brdzi ba'i mthu chen po thob pas mthar thug byang chub mchog gi go 'phang la myur du reg pa dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud sogs las lhag pa'i lha'i rigs ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum du 'du zhing*/ de rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po'ang*/ 'jam dpal/ spyan ras gzigs/ phyag na rdo rje gsum du nges pas/ 'di'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pas rigs thams cad kyi bsnyen pa las su rung zhing dngos sgrub bsgrub pa la dbang bas mtshon dgos pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bye brag 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i gzungs/ phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi rgyud sogs sngags rgyud rab 'byams dang*/ mdo sde rin po che rnams nas 'phags pa 'di gsum gyi mtshan bzung ba dang*/ sku'i snang brnyan yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde tha dag yid bzhin du stsol ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas 'phags bod kyi ljongs su sngon byon mkhas grub rim par byon pa rnams kyang*/ 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi rnam 'phrul sha stag zam ma chad par byon nas bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher spel bar mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar mthong chos su gyur pas na/ rjes 'jug skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams kyis kyang 'phags pa rigs gsum 'di nyid bsnyen cing gsol ba btab na 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gdon mi za bas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/

phan yon de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub par byed pa la'ang sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa'i rim pa rnams kho bos sngon du legs par grub zin nas/ da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba'i rim pa la'ang sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la'ang maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gtso bor gyur pa'i 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po la gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos la/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod de tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa la sogs yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum/ des rgyud dag par byas nas/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs pa rnams ni rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā sogs brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa gzung 'dzin tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i go sar pam̐ las pad+ma'i gdan gsum gyi dbus dang g.yas phyogs kyi pad+ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ g.yon phyogs kyi pad+ma'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa/ g.yas su hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs nas/ stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yon du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyag na rdo rje sogs nas/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ gsum ga'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gsal btab/ slob dpon la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud mdzad pas slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ grub pa brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong dang rig 'dzin la sogs pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa rig gsum gyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/

khyed rang rnams la thim/ de bzhin du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ spos dkar gyi dud pa bdug cing dril bu gsil ba dang bcas pas/ sngags gsum po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya āḥdang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbatags pa mang du brjod la bstim/ de nas bum pa'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs gsum gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha'i gtso bo dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bum pa mgor bzhag cing bum chu 'thung du'ang bcug la/ zhes gsung bzhin dbang bskur bas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dngos grub thams cad thob/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi skur gyur pa brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ des bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ gnas skabs su sku sgom pa dang*/ sku'i phrin las tha dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing*/

mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams gnyis ka 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ yig rnams gsal btab la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa byung ba zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa byas/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te sngags rnams kyi rjes zlos lan bdun gnang bar zhu/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul gyis me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlab par mos/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rigs gsum spyi'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de dang rjes su 'brel pa dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di bzhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o// des bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ gnas skabs su gsung bzlas pa dang*/ gsung gi phrin las tha dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung 'grub pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'am byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas/ grub pa brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du yang mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kar phog de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad kyi ngo bo ral gri dang*/ pad+ma dkar po dang*/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i rnam par bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon te khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas thugs ka'i sa bon dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i ngang nas khyed rang rnams lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu de nyid la yid cher gyis gtad pa la brten nas 'khor rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhing*/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba yang sku'i stod smad nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon de'ang je chung che phrar gyur te/ mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar rang yal du yal ba la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ci yang ma grub pa spros bral nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod la de'i ngang la ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog par zhu/

des bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum mgon po'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ gnas skabs su thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bsgom pa dang*/ thugs kyi phrin las tha dag sgrub pa la dbang zhing*/ mthar thug gi ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang de dag brtan par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar rigs gsum gyi lha tshogs la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas grub pa brnyes pa'i lha dang klu dang drang srong dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ slob dpon lhan cig pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' sogs dang*/ bcom ldan gser mdog ri yi rgyal po 'dra// 'jig rten gsum na 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i sku// bcom ldan sku yi bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bcom ldan dung mdog= /'jig rten gsum na spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung*// bcom ldan gsung sogs gong bzhin// bcom ldan mthing mdog= /'jig rten gsum na phyag na rdo rje'i thugs// bcom ldan thugs kyi sogs 'dra/ mthar bdag cag sogs/ bkra shis kyi tshig ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o// de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes su gnang ba legs par grub pas/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams la srung sdom bzhin du bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ zhes pas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ rjes su gnang ba zab mo legs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang*/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus dang longs spyod la sogs pa rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul gyis cha shas nas kyang bzhes la longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum spyi'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo legs par thob pa yin pas gnas skabs su gnas dus kyi rgud pa zhi zhing*/ mthar thug phan bde'i lam bzang thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa sogs kyi phan yon nges pa'i sgo nas bzlas brjod dang gsol 'debs la brtson pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis/ sogs bsngo smon ci rigs pa byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ rjes kyi rim pa ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la gong ltar byin brlab sngon du 'gro bas mtshan sngags re re zhing sbyar bas/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar/ dharmā ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ sku gsung thugs 'jam sogs kyis bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das/ zhes sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol la/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥzhes mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas pas/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrungs la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rigs gsum lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo smon dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshig ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par byas la mchod gtor sogs bsdus la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// zhes rigs gsum spyi'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dge legs lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang*/ thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi shing rta chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol pa 'jam mgon thams cad gzigs pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas kyi tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang phrin las pha mtha' yas pa'i nang tshan yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun tu lo thog la sad ser btsa' than sogs gnas dus kyi rgud pa zhi phyir rje nyid kyi bsti gnas rdzong sar bkra shis lha rtses mtshon dgon sde phal mo cher rigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod kyi rgyun tshugs sar yul lugs dang mthun par skye bo pho mo khrom tshogs la bskur du rung ba'i rjes gnang zhig yod na legs pa rgyu mtshan du mdzad nas/

sde dge chos rgyal chen po dbus nas mar phebs pa'i lcags stag lor 'byor phyag la bcar skabs mchod yon thun mong la thugs rje chen po bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi smin grol cha lag dang bcas pa dang*/ phran chung sger la'ang tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe khrid sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du bka' drin stsal nas zhar byung du 'di dang*/ tshe lha rnam gsum spyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang bcas bka' drin stsal zhing*/ 'di gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi rgyun dmigs bsal mi bzhugs kyang*/ spyi bka'i sgrub thabs brgya rgyam sogs dang*/ zur bka' rigs gsum so so'i rjes gnang mang du bzhugs pa dag la khungs su byas nas gsar du chog sgrigs mdzad pa la 'gal ba med ces bka'i 'phros don zhib tu bstsal zhing*/ de rjes shing rta lor nged rang bkra shis pho brang du bdag po yab sras mdun bcar skabs rdzong sar dbu zur bla ma yon tan lhun grub nas rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang zhig dgos zhes gsungs kyang*/ dpe med pas dgon du phyag dpe'i khrod na bzhugs yod snyam pas g.yar po zhus kyang ma bzhugs pas/ slar yang bla ma yon tan lhun grub nas rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang gi chog sgrigs zhig nges par dgos zhes nan tan du gsung bar brten/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i zhal snga nas byin rlabs kyi rgyun thob pa nyid khungs su byas/ bdag mdun bskyed chog rnams rigs gsum dkyil chog las zur du blangs/ rigs gsum bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag bskyed rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bsgom par gsungs kyang*/ rjes gnang skabs mdun bskyed la rten bskyed pa med pas/ bdag bskyed la gzhal yas khang med pa 'thad dam snyam pas rten gyi bskyed chog dor/ bum dbang zhig mdzad 'dug par brten bum sgrub zhig bcug rjes gnang dngos rgyud sde 'og ma'i rigs kyi rjes gnang zur bka'i rigs yig cha khungs thub kyi 'gros sbyar/

mtshams sbyor gyi tshig sna cung zad bsrings te dge sbyong gi rtags 'dzin dpal ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis myos byed kyi lo tha skar zla ba'i yar tshes la/ dpal brtse ba chen po'i dus dran gyi mchod par dmigs te lhun grub steng gi nor 'dzin gyi phyogs kyi nyin dgon pho brang du bris pa 'di la nongs pa mchis na bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum gyi spyan sngar bzod par gsol zhing*/ dge bas mkha' mnyam yid can thams cad rigs gsum gyi go 'phang la reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
